benchmarks.name: CaP-Bench (Coding Agents for Robot Manipulation)
benchmarks.description: First comprehensive benchmark for evaluating LLM coding agents on robotic manipulation. 39 tasks across 8 tiers (S1-S4 single-turn + M1-M4 multi-turn), varying by abstraction levels, interaction modes, and visual grounding modalities. Tasks drawn from Robosuite + LIBERO-PRO (130+ tasks) + BEHAVIOR-1K. Robot platforms: Franka Panda + R1Pro. Companion components: CaP-Gym (interactive env), CaP-Agent0 (training-free framework), CaP-RL (RL pipeline). NVIDIA + Stanford + Berkeley + UT Austin (arxiv 2603.22435, Mar 2026).
